notes: Populated existing story IDs for Board Certification Verification. No new IDs created.

change_log.value: Defined schema and contract for board certification verification output
Implemented extraction and verification logic from NPI data
Expose board certification via EvaluateCare facade

stories.title: Define Board Certification Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a normalized schema for board certification signals derived from NPI registry data, including certification presence, certifying board name, status (if available), and confidence flags for missing or partial data.

stories.title: Implement Board Certification Extraction and Verification Logic
stories.description: Parse NPI registry response fields to extract credential strings, identify board certification indicators, normalize board names, and determine verification status using deterministic rules. Handle missing, inconsistent, or free-text credentials.

stories.title: Expose Board Certification via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate board certification signals into provider detail response and expose through evaluate_care_facade so downstream chat and UI layers can consume structured certification data.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Board Certification Verification
stories.description: Create unit tests for extraction and normalization logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from NPI lookup through facade response, including edge cases with missing or ambiguous credential data.

per_feature.mitigation: Use deterministic parsing with fallback 'unknown' states to avoid false claims.

per_measure.mitigation: Surface uncertainty explicitly when NPI data is incomplete.
